approval_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER approval_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON approval BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approval records are immutable'); END
approval_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER approval_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON approval BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approval records are immutable'); END
board_list_archive_guard: CREATE TRIGGER board_list_archive_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF archived ON board_list WHEN OLD.archived=0 AND NEW.archived=1 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_placement WHERE list_id=OLD.id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM board_list WHERE archived=0) <= 1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot archive a nonempty list or the last active list'); END
board_placement_insert_guard: CREATE TRIGGER board_placement_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON board_placement WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_list WHERE id=NEW.list_id AND archived=0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'placement requires an active board list'); END
board_placement_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER board_placement_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF list_id ON board_placement WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_list WHERE id=NEW.list_id AND archived=0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'placement requires an active board list'); END
brief_scope_insert_guard: CREATE TRIGGER brief_scope_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON brief_item WHEN (NEW.scope_kind='party' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity WHERE id=NEW.scope_id AND kind IN ('person','org'))) OR (NEW.scope_kind='segment' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM segment WHERE id=NEW.scope_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'brief scope does not exist or has the wrong type'); END
brief_scope_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER brief_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF scope_kind,scope_id ON brief_item WHEN (NEW.scope_kind='party' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity WHERE id=NEW.scope_id AND kind IN ('person','org'))) OR (NEW.scope_kind='segment' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM segment WHERE id=NEW.scope_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'brief scope does not exist or has the wrong type'); END
cited_interest_revision_invalidation: CREATE TRIGGER cited_interest_revision_invalidation AFTER UPDATE OF current_revision ON claim WHEN OLD.current_revision <> NEW.current_revision BEGIN UPDATE opportunity_interest SET revision=revision+1 WHERE claim_id=NEW.id AND claim_revision <> NEW.current_revision; UPDATE opportunity SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id IN (SELECT opportunity_id FROM opportunity_interest WHERE claim_id=NEW.id); INSERT INTO event(event_id,occurred_at,entity_type,entity_id,revision,event_type,payload_json) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),'opportunity',o.id,o.revision, 'opportunity.source_claim_corrected',json_object('claim_id',NEW.id,'claim_revision',NEW.current_revision) FROM opportunity o WHERE o.id IN (SELECT opportunity_id FROM opportunity_interest WHERE claim_id=NEW.id); END
coach_question_revision_monotonic: CREATE TRIGGER coach_question_revision_monotonic BEFORE UPDATE OF status,disposition_json,selector_json,target_json,deferred_until,dependency_json,semantic_key ON coach_question WHEN NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'coach question revision must advance by one'); END
discard_party_stage_receipts: CREATE TRIGGER discard_party_stage_receipts BEFORE DELETE ON party_import_stage BEGIN DELETE FROM idempotency_receipt WHERE owner_id=1 AND epoch=OLD.epoch AND key IN (SELECT key FROM party_stage_receipt WHERE stage_id=OLD.id AND epoch=OLD.epoch); END
durable_job_terminal_guard: CREATE TRIGGER durable_job_terminal_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON durable_job WHEN OLD.status IN ('succeeded','invalid','failed','cancelled') AND NEW.status<>OLD.status BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal jobs cannot be reopened'); END
event_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON event BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'event log is append-only'); END
event_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON event WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erasure_authorization WHERE entity_id = OLD.entity_id) AND NEW.entity_id='erased' AND NEW.payload_json='{"erased":true}') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'event log is append-only'); END
inference_active_identity_required: CREATE TRIGGER inference_active_identity_required BEFORE INSERT ON durable_job WHEN (NEW.profile_revision IS NOT NULL OR NEW.equivalence_key IS NOT NULL) AND (NEW.equivalence_key IS NULL OR NEW.owner_pseudonym IS NULL OR NEW.epoch = '') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'inference job requires active identity'); END
inference_active_profile_requires_evalua: CREATE TRIGGER inference_active_profile_requires_evaluation_on_insert BEFORE INSERT ON inference_active_profile WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inference_qualification q WHERE q.profile_revision = NEW.profile_revision AND q.status = 'ready' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inference_profile_revocation r WHERE r.profile_revision = NEW.profile_revision ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'profile needs a qualified capability'); END

CREATE TRIGGER inference_active_profile_requires_evaluation_on_update BEFORE UPDATE ON inference_active_profile WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inference_qualification q WHERE q.profile_revision = NEW.profile_revision AND q.status = 'ready' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inference_profile_revocation r WHERE r.profile_revision = NEW.profile_revision ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'profile needs a qualified capability'); END
inference_profile_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER inference_profile_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON inference_profile BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'inference profiles are immutable'); END
inference_record_at_admission: CREATE TRIGGER inference_record_at_admission AFTER INSERT ON durable_job BEGIN INSERT INTO inference_record(id,role,status,created_at,completed_at,metadata_class) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.role,NEW.status,NEW.created_at,NEW.completed_at,'historical_unknown'); UPDATE durable_job SET epoch = (SELECT epoch FROM workspace_meta WHERE singleton = 1) WHERE id = NEW.id AND NEW.epoch = '' AND NEW.run_id IS NULL; END
inference_record_status: CREATE TRIGGER inference_record_status AFTER UPDATE OF status ON durable_job WHEN NEW.status <> OLD.status BEGIN UPDATE inference_record SET status = NEW.status,completed_at = NEW.completed_at, error_code = CASE WHEN NEW.status IN ('failed','invalid','cancelled') THEN NEW.last_error_code END WHERE id = NEW.id; UPDATE durable_job SET state_revision = OLD.state_revision + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id AND NEW.state_revision = OLD.state_revision; DELETE FROM coach_question_hold WHERE job_id = NEW.id AND NEW.status IN ('succeeded','failed','invalid','cancelled'); END
job_attempt_result_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER job_attempt_result_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON job_attempt WHEN OLD.status<>'running' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal job attempts are immutable'); END
material_lint_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER material_lint_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON material_lint BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'lint history is immutable'); END
material_lint_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER material_lint_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON material_lint BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'lint results are immutable for a material version'); END
material_version_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER material_version_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON material_version BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'material versions are immutable'); END
material_version_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER material_version_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON material_version BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'material versions are immutable'); END
material_version_snapshot_resource_attac: CREATE TRIGGER material_version_snapshot_resource_attachment AFTER INSERT ON material_version WHEN NEW.blob_upload_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO delivered_resource_version(resource_id,material_id,version_no,resource_revision,resource_title) SELECT e.id,NEW.material_id,NEW.version_no,e.revision,e.name FROM entity_attachment a JOIN entity e ON e.id=a.entity_id WHERE a.upload_id=NEW.blob_upload_id AND e.subtype<>'' AND e.readiness<>'retired'; END
outcome_revision_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER outcome_revision_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON outcome_revision BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'outcome revisions are append-only'); END
outcome_revision_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER outcome_revision_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON outcome_revision BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'outcome revisions are append-only'); END
outcome_revision_seed: CREATE TRIGGER outcome_revision_seed AFTER INSERT ON outcome BEGIN INSERT INTO outcome_revision(send_id,revision,class,rung_accepted,received_at,recorded_at,note,correction_reason) VALUES(NEW.send_id,1,NEW.class,NEW.rung_accepted,NEW.received_at,NEW.recorded_at,NEW.note,NULL); END
release_issuance_only: CREATE TRIGGER release_issuance_only BEFORE UPDATE ON release_record WHEN NOT (NEW.id = OLD.id AND NEW.approval_id = OLD.approval_id AND NEW.material_id = OLD.material_id AND NEW.version_no = OLD.version_no AND NEW.content_sha256 = OLD.content_sha256 AND NEW.issued_at = OLD.issued_at AND NEW.acknowledged = OLD.acknowledged AND NEW.acknowledged_at IS OLD.acknowledged_at AND (NEW.bytes_issued_at IS OLD.bytes_issued_at OR (OLD.bytes_issued_at IS NULL AND NEW.bytes_issued_at IS NOT NULL)) AND NEW.transfer_incomplete = OLD.transfer_incomplete) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'release issuance fields are append-only'); END
release_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER release_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON release_record BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'release records are immutable'); END
resource_placement_insert_guard: CREATE TRIGGER resource_placement_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON resource_placement WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity WHERE id=NEW.resource_id AND subtype<>'' AND retired_at IS NULL AND readiness<>'retired') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'placement requires an active resource'); END
resource_placement_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER resource_placement_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF resource_id ON resource_placement WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity WHERE id=NEW.resource_id AND subtype<>'' AND retired_at IS NULL AND readiness<>'retired') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'placement requires an active resource'); END
source_opportunity_insert_guard: CREATE TRIGGER source_opportunity_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON source_opportunity_link WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunity WHERE id=NEW.opportunity_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_variant WHERE id=NEW.source_variant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'source or opportunity does not exist'); END
source_opportunity_update_guard: CREATE TRIGGER source_opportunity_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF opportunity_id,source_variant_id ON source_opportunity_link WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunity WHERE id=NEW.opportunity_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_variant WHERE id=NEW.source_variant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'source or opportunity does not exist'); END
template_build_candidate_revision_monoto: CREATE TRIGGER template_build_candidate_revision_monotonic BEFORE UPDATE OF status,saved_version_id,preview_json ON template_build_candidate WHEN NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'template build candidate revision must advance by one'); END
template_content_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER template_content_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF family_id,version_no,body,fallbacks_json,content_sha256,created_at ON template_version BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'template version content is immutable'); END
template_s09_content_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER template_s09_content_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF family_id,version_no,body,fallbacks_json,content_sha256,created_at,rules_json,display_name,stage_class,channel,parent_version_id ON template_version BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'template version content is immutable'); END
template_version_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER template_version_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON template_version BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'template versions are immutable'); END
